notes: Source/test-definition audit and document consistency checks only. No new runtime guarantees; no deployment, production mutation, or financial transaction.

tasks.title: Define the versioned InsuranceProduct envelope

fields.Objective: Define `InsuranceProductDefinitionV1` and immutable artifact/version references without replacing existing product or policy schemas.
fields.Files: New `packages/domain/src/product-definition.ts`, `product-canonical.ts`, corresponding tests and exports.
fields.Acceptance: Validate identity, schema version, synthetic marker, organization/party-role references, wording and typed definition references. Reject unknown versions/keys, invalid monetary representations and executable configuration. Canonical content and its domain-separated digest have golden vectors; publication metadata is excluded. A descriptive non-Arc fixture needs no EVM address or USDC.
fields.Security: Definition references request approved capabilities; no embedded token, authority grant, executable script or arbitrary callback URL.
fields.Compatibility: Additive exports only; old `CoverageProduct`, `CoverageTerms`, `ProcurementTerms`, IDs and terms digests remain untouched. No registry, database, route or runtime consumer yet.

tasks.title: Specify product publication transitions

fields.Objective: Model draft, review, approved and retired revisions with separately recorded review/approval provenance.
fields.Files: New `packages/domain/src/product-lifecycle.ts` and tests.
fields.Acceptance: Pure transition tests cover allowed/forbidden edges, stale revision rejection, approval tied to an exact content digest, edits requiring a new revision, and retirement preserving historical retrieval. A review may return to a new draft revision; approved content cannot be edited or restored as a mutable draft.
fields.Security: A creator cannot self-approve by changing status. An abstract trusted authorization decision is an input contract, not proof that authentication or legally valid authority has been implemented.
fields.Compatibility: No existing active boolean or issued policy is reinterpreted. Persistent publication enforcement is delivered only by A5 after E1/E2/E4.

tasks.title: Type exposure, trigger, coverage and evidence definitions

fields.Objective: Describe what is insured and which facts establish each product's contractual conditions.
fields.Files: New domain modules `coverage-definition.ts`, `evidence-requirements.ts` and tests; compose with A1 artifact references.
fields.Acceptance: Typed occurrence, claims-made/reporting, discovery/reporting and circumstance conditions; explicit date roles, sublimits, exclusions/clauses, loss/benefit method references and evidence requirements. Unknown information remains explicit. Validate indemnity and parametric specimens plus a nonfinancial exposure. Reject dangling IDs, incompatible types and impossible date/limit relationships.
fields.Security: Evidence authenticity, assertion and recommendation are separate types. Do not put private evidence bytes in a published product or treat a digest as proof of truth.
fields.Compatibility: Keep legacy USDC math, current event-window behavior and V1 evidence payloads unchanged; this task introduces no payout evaluator.

tasks.title: Define conditional questionnaires

fields.Objective: Make submission/FNOL requirements product-specific and versioned.
fields.Files: New `packages/domain/src/questionnaire.ts` and tests; test fixtures under `packages/domain/src/__fixtures__/` (proposed).
fields.Acceptance: Validate stable question IDs, answer types, required/conditional fields and document references. Detect unknown references, cycles and ambiguous conditions. Missing facts return a list of requirements. Include the current four attestations and a small enterprise-AI template traceable to the source document, preserving its evidence classifications.
fields.Security: Bounded declarative predicates only; no arbitrary expressions or network access. Support data classification/minimization metadata without requesting hidden model chain-of-thought.
fields.Compatibility: No replacement of the current form or stored answers; no implication that a template is a carrier-approved application.

tasks.title: Persist approved bundles and pin new policy snapshots

fields.Objective: Add the governed registry and immutable references required for new product-aware offers and policies.
fields.Files: Additive `packages/persistence/src/migrations/`, product repositories; application registry service in `packages/insurance`; new policy-version sidecar repository.
fields.Acceptance: Transactionally publish only an authorized exact bundle with all approved references resolvable. Uniqueness is tenant/product/version scoped. New sidecars pin product/workflow/rules/evidence/wording hashes. Editing or retirement cannot alter an issued snapshot. Copy-database upgrades and repeated application preserve old rows and digests.
fields.Security: Server authority and tenant checks gate publication. Deletion cannot erase issued-policy provenance. Missing historical approvals are never invented.
fields.Complexity: L; review schema/repository and policy-sidecar integration as separate commits.
fields.Compatibility: Existing payload bytes and hash domains stay unchanged; historical records remain explicitly legacy/unpinned. No production migration or new issuance in this task.

tasks.title: Describe the oracle product as Product Version 1

fields.Objective: Encode the current concrete product as a fully resolved local definition bundle before redirecting live code.
fields.Files: New domain fixture bundle and compatibility tests against `domain/procurement.ts` and `agent-sdk/procurement.ts`.
fields.Acceptance: Preserve code, wording, exclusions, synthetic status, 1/10/50/100 USDC menus, 1/7/30 day durations, premium/100 and deductible/10 formulas, 600s quote TTL and 900s effective delay. Fixed-input quote snapshot/digest comparison proves semantic equality. Keep the separate legacy synthetic product identifiable.
fields.Security: Label demo pricing and fixture-consistency evidence explicitly; do not mark the bundle insurer-approved or enable an executable rule by its name alone.
fields.Compatibility: Fixture/definition only; no old runtime import replaced, policy backfill, contract change or rehashing.

tasks.title: Record risk submissions and revisions

fields.Objective: Persist product-specific applications independently of quotes or policies.
fields.Files: New domain submission contract, insurance submission service, persistence migration/repository and authenticated route.
fields.Acceptance: Product/questionnaire/input revisions and evidence references are pinned. Applicant and insured-role records are explicit. Authorized corrections append revisions. Missing required answers produce a requirements response; idempotency key conflicts reject changed input. Tenant-crossing document/submission access fails.
fields.Security: Distinguish enterprise identity/authorization from wallet control; minimize confidential fields and enforce per-record access.
fields.Compatibility: Existing registration remains available; no migration infers enterprise legal identity from its wallet.

tasks.title: Implement dry-run underwriting decisions

fields.Objective: Produce explainable `eligible`, `needs_information`, `refer` or `decline` results without issuing a quote.
fields.Files: New `packages/insurance/src/underwriting-dry-run.ts` and tests; versioned domain result contract.
fields.Acceptance: Evaluate the resolved oracle bundle and local submission specimens with explicit clock/rule/input versions. Include matched rule IDs, reasons, missing requirements and candidate pricing marked synthetic/unapproved. Unknown inputs never silently pass. Replaying identical inputs is deterministic.
fields.Security: Output contains no quote/bind/payment authority or model-based universal risk score; reject executable or unregistered rating methods.
fields.Compatibility: Local/in-memory evaluator only; existing quote behavior and financial code are untouched. B1 is not needed to exercise this pure boundary.

tasks.title: Validate allowlisted workflow definitions

fields.Objective: Define safe typed steps and conditional routing without building a general editor or runtime.
fields.Files: Domain workflow contracts/validator and tests; concrete allowlisted step catalog in insurance.
fields.Acceptance: Resolve input/output types, version references, transitions, terminal outcomes and allowed capabilities. Reject unreachable steps, missing references, unsupported capabilities, unbounded loops/retries and contradictory conditions. Model the current placement and claims paths as test definitions.
fields.Security: No arbitrary code, shell/SQL, unrestricted fetch, client-provided executor or workflow-minted authority.
fields.Compatibility: Existing state machines remain authoritative; validation alone enables no runtime action.

tasks.title: Persist workflow runs with bounded retries and waits

fields.Objective: Execute approved concrete steps durably while retaining owner-service authorization.
fields.Files: Insurance workflow-run service, persistence run/event/outbox tables, tests and an internal worker integration.
fields.Acceptance: Pin the bundle, run revision, inputs and outputs. Test waits for information/human/receipt, bounded retry/deadline handling, crash recovery and duplicate deliveries. Fail closed on missing/retired capabilities. Replaying events does not repeat an external effect.
fields.Security: Worker identities have explicit scope; every side effect is reauthorized at execution. No money-moving operation is enabled by default.
fields.Complexity: L; separate durable state, recovery and one concrete operation integration.
fields.Compatibility: Start with a nonfinancial collection/referral capability; old procurement and ClaimsCase transitions continue unchanged.

tasks.title: Authorize product-aware quotes and issuance conditions

fields.Objective: Connect approved bundles and underwriting decisions to new offers while separating quote, acceptance, bind preparation and issuance.
fields.Files: Insurance quote/issuance service; narrow adapters at `agent-sdk/procurement.ts` and server procurement routes; tests.
fields.Acceptance: Require current issuer/underwriter authority and subjectivity clearance. Bind exact submitted/approved terms and premium, expiry, parties and asset. Expired or changed accepted digests fail. Distinguish written/legal issuance confirmation where the product requires it from settlement receipts.
fields.Security: Applicant/agent permissions do not establish insurer bind authority; no dry-run recommendation bypasses referral.
fields.Compatibility: Opt in only new offers; unchanged V1 routes and frozen policies remain readable. No deployment or financial execution is part of the PR.

tasks.title: Add deterministic scenario and decision traces

fields.Objective: Make underwriting/workflow/checkpoint reasoning inspectable before activating a new bundle.
fields.Files: Local scenario runner/test harness in insurance; JSON-safe trace contract and fixtures.
fields.Acceptance: Trace versioned inputs, rules, clause/evidence references and outcome reasons; compare accept/refer/decline/unknown examples. Stable replays exclude wall-clock nondeterminism and secrets. Trace explains why a step was not applicable.
fields.Security: Traces contain references/redacted metadata, not confidential documents, hidden chain-of-thought or credentials.
fields.Compatibility: A diagnostic harness only; passing a scenario is not insurer approval or policy issuance.

tasks.title: Make policy lifecycle projections explicit

fields.Objective: Represent preparation, submission, canonical binding, effective coverage, freshness and financial state independently.
fields.Files: Domain read contracts, server `policy-read-api.ts`, coverage/policies panels and read-contract tests.
fields.Acceptance: Status cannot say effective from an old receipt alone. Test scheduled/effective/expired windows, stale/failed/reorged checkpoints and correct policy-scoped warnings. Preserve historical evidence without presenting it as current status. Refresh and expired-view behavior are explicit.
fields.Security: Claims/financial eligibility stays server-authoritative and fail-closed; cosmetic status cannot grant a capability.
fields.Compatibility: Version the new projection and retain V1 reads for current clients; historical unlinked rows remain visible in the appropriate portfolio context.

tasks.title: Append authorized endorsements and cancellation instructions

fields.Objective: Manage requested policy changes without editing original issued terms.
fields.Files: Domain policy-change records, insurance change service, additive persistence and tests.
fields.Acceptance: Track request, proposed schedule, effective interval, authorizations and confirmation. Reject retroactive overwrites, overlap ambiguity and unauthorized beneficiary/coverage changes. A rejected request leaves the original policy unchanged.
fields.Security: Carrier-specific consent, notice and rights are prerequisites, not universal defaults. Financial changes require separately authorized supported actions.
fields.Compatibility: Initial local administration records only. Current pool cannot rewrite issued terms; reject unsupported execution instead of pretending an offchain endorsement changed the contract.

tasks.title: Model renewals, lapse and expiry

fields.Objective: Prepare a new term/offer and record scheduling without silently extending coverage.
fields.Files: Domain renewal schedule, insurance administration functions, persistence and tests.
fields.Acceptance: Renewal creates a distinct quote/policy revision as required; expiry is deterministic. Test grace/notice settings only when defined by the product, declined renewals, missing acceptance and time-zone boundaries. No automatic premium debit.
fields.Security: A reminder or prior wallet allowance cannot authorize a renewal or waive required consent.
fields.Compatibility: Existing contract end timestamps and quoted terms are immutable; do not reinterpret a new offer as continuous cover.

tasks.title: Track insured assets, sublimits and aggregate capacity

fields.Objective: Apply product-specific allocation and accumulation constraints across covered exposures.
fields.Files: Domain allocation/aggregate records, insurance reservation functions, persistence constraints and tests.
fields.Acceptance: Concurrent allocations cannot exceed policy/section/aggregate caps. Distinguish capital-pool capacity, contractual aggregate and external insurer capacity. Exercise multiple assets, released reservations and related-loss aggregation.
fields.Security: Authoritative capacity adjustments require role/reason; a workflow cannot invent funding or reduce existing liabilities.
fields.Compatibility: Preserve current full-collateralized USDC math; do not sum synthetic ledger and live pool balances as one asset.

tasks.title: Define payment intents and the concrete Arc capability boundary

fields.Objective: Separate policy/claim decisions from rail preparation, external execution and reconciliation.
fields.Files: Domain payment-intent/asset contracts, insurance intent orchestration, narrow adapter around existing onchain preparation/read helpers and tests.
fields.Acceptance: Bind exact asset, amount, recipient, purpose, case/policy, authority and idempotency reference. Prepare/submit/verify/reconcile states are distinct. Arc capability validation rejects non-USDC, incompatible claim-payment windows and unsupported amendments. Test timeout/unknown outcomes without live sends.
fields.Security: No new signer, allowance, automatic broadcast or second rail. Revalidate authorization and beneficiary at execution; receipts must match exact intent.
fields.Compatibility: Keep ABI, contract, entity hashes and existing transaction helpers. Rail abstraction does not weaken financial controls or assert support for fiat.

tasks.title: Add product-specific evidence requirements and verification attestations

fields.Objective: Replace a generic completeness assertion with evaluated requirements and identifiable verification records.
fields.Files: Insurance evidence service/evaluator, persistence metadata/attestation tables and access-checked routes; tests.
fields.Acceptance: Separate assertion, collection, integrity, source authentication, sufficiency and interpretation. Each required item has an explicit state/reason. Changing evidence invalidates dependent approval bindings. Test forged verification labels, conflicting sources, absent originals and stale attestations.
fields.Security: Hash alone does not mean authentic. Tenant/object access, confidentiality, privilege/retention references and synthetic labels are mandatory; do not put evidence bytes on chain.
fields.Compatibility: Retain existing manifests and roots. Old metadata is not silently promoted to a stronger verification level; no speculative external collector is added.

tasks.title: Define the nine-checkpoint adjudication dossier

fields.Objective: Separate trigger/notice, insured scope, classification, causation, liability, coverage, quantum, resolution authority and closure.
fields.Files: New domain claim-determination contracts, insurance validators and fixtures/tests.
fields.Acceptance: Each checkpoint records result, evidence/clauses, actor/version, missing facts and reason. Liability may be not applicable only under an explicit product rule. Full/partial acceptance, pending information, referral, decline and authorized defence/reservation are distinct proposed outcomes.
fields.Security: No AI recommendation or technical incident proves liability/coverage/quantum; a dossier alone grants no settlement authority.
fields.Compatibility: Add a dossier alongside ClaimsCase; do not change terminal V1 states or route all products through a liability decision.

tasks.title: Implement dry-run Tier 1/2/3 routing

fields.Objective: Explain handling assignments using approved product-specific criteria rather than claim value alone.
fields.Files: New insurance triage evaluator/result types and tests.
fields.Acceptance: Evaluate amount, uncertainty, coverage conflict, fraud indicators, common-cause accumulation, specialist needs and authority availability. Missing/contradictory facts escalate. Test a small disputed loss and larger clean parametric case; mandatory escalation overrides amount rules. Return required authority and reasons, never a payment instruction.
fields.Security: A tier/confidence score cannot authorize payout. Sensitive claimant data is used only under explicit product/organization policy and restricted access.
fields.Compatibility: Local/dry-run first; existing REVIEW and authorized settlement gates remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Record evidence-linked examiner recommendations

fields.Objective: Support advisory case analyses without integrating an AI provider or enabling decisions.
fields.Files: Domain recommendation/provenance schema, insurance advisory ingestion/validation, persistence and tests using fixtures.
fields.Acceptance: Store input/evidence versions, producer/model reference if any, proposed chronology/checkpoints, discrepancies and citations. Invalid/missing citations reject or mark unsubstantiated. A new recommendation cannot overwrite evidence or approved adjudication.
fields.Security: Treat external/model text as untrusted; no tool execution, credentials, authority changes or payment capabilities. Do not ingest hidden chain-of-thought.
fields.Compatibility: Fixture/import-only advisory records; a real model-provider integration requires a later tracked scope expansion and data-processing approval.

tasks.title: Extend the human review workbench with scoped decisions

fields.Objective: Present the dossier and recommendations to an authorized reviewer with documented referral paths.
fields.Files: Claims review components/routes, insurance review commands and integration tests.
fields.Acceptance: Show evidence provenance, chronology, conflicts, relevant clauses, quantum and required approvals. Reviewers can request information, refer or decide only within scope. Concurrent/stale approval attempts fail. Partial determinations preserve each head of loss and do not silently enable unsupported payout execution.
fields.Security: Server-enforce amount/product/tenant limits and separation of duties; AI output is visibly advisory.
fields.Compatibility: Keep current reviewer/authority workflow; new capabilities are opt-in with versioned decisions and no live settlement execution.

tasks.title: Record complaints, appeals, recoveries and controlled reopening

fields.Objective: Preserve post-decision rights/processes and feed back documented learning without rewriting history.
fields.Files: New domain post-claim records, insurance commands, persistence and minimal review UI/tests.
fields.Acceptance: Append complaint/appeal/recovery records with applicable deadlines and decision ownership. Reopening creates a new authorized investigation revision; old decisions remain visible. New payment proposals recheck prior/committed compensation. Underwriting feedback requires review.
fields.Security: No automatic reversal, recovery debit, subrogation action or reuse of claimant evidence for training. Protect legal hold and privileged material.
fields.Compatibility: V1 DENIED/PAID rows remain historical terminal records; use versioned follow-on processes rather than mutating their meaning.

tasks.title: Establish organization, tenant and principal scope

fields.Objective: Add organization membership and independently authenticated actor/capability context before enterprise write APIs.
fields.Files: Domain identity contracts, server authentication mapping, persistence constraints/repositories and negative integration tests.
fields.Acceptance: Every new record, object reference, command, idempotency key and read is tenant-scoped. Test cross-tenant guessed IDs, inherited roles, agent delegation, reviewer access and audit leaks. Explicitly represent the existing beta's single-tenant scope.
fields.Security: Wallet possession is neither company identity nor insurer authority. Never trust client-supplied tenant/role fields without membership verification.
fields.Compatibility: Do not silently broaden current global operator permissions into enterprise tenants. Multi-tenant access stays disabled until isolation tests pass.

tasks.title: Model independent authority grants

fields.Objective: Separate product authorship from publish, underwriting, quote, bind, adjudication and settlement rights.
fields.Files: Domain authority-grant/decision types, insurance evaluator, persistence and tests.
fields.Acceptance: Scope grants by issuer/subject/tenant/product/version/action, validity, recipient restrictions, per-case/cumulative limits, delegation depth, revocation and required co-approvals. Missing, expired, revoked or out-of-scope grants deny. Product configuration cannot create or elevate a grant.
fields.Security: Bootstrapping a grant requires a reviewed organization authority root; a database role or approval flag is not legal authority.
fields.Compatibility: Map existing beta roles conservatively; preserve its designated on-chain authority and disclose backend-only delegation limitations.

tasks.title: Recheck authority and approval bindings at command execution

fields.Objective: Prevent stale authorization, concurrent budget overspend and self-approval at consequential command boundaries.
fields.Files: Insurance command guards, server mutation adapters, transaction tests.
fields.Acceptance: Revalidate exact version/input/evidence/amount/beneficiary, grant expiry/revocation and reserved cumulative capacity in the transaction. Enforce distinct approvers where required. Test replay, changed recipient, delayed command and concurrent approvals.
fields.Security: No majority vote, confidence score or workflow-admin override. Unknown execution outcomes remain blocked pending reconciliation.
fields.Compatibility: Apply to new commands through adapters; do not claim old executable EOA calldata can be revoked by backend checks.

tasks.title: Extend audit and decision provenance

fields.Objective: Record how a versioned configuration, evidence set and authority decision produced a command or outcome.
fields.Files: Domain audit envelope, persistence append-only event helpers and tests; minimal trace reads.
fields.Acceptance: Correlate tenant, actor, command/idempotency ID, record revision, product/workflow/rules/evidence versions, reasons and authorization references. Commit audit with state changes; retries do not duplicate effects. Redacted views retain traceability.
fields.Security: Exclude secrets and unnecessary personal/privileged data; define access and retention references. Append-only application events are not by themselves tamper-proof storage.
fields.Compatibility: Preserve old audit rows and serializers; do not rewrite historical actors or present a stronger audit guarantee than the storage provides.

tasks.title: Preserve loss, reservation, idempotency and reconciliation invariants

fields.Objective: Build the shared transactional commitment/outbox boundary required by new commands.
fields.Files: Insurance accounting/commitment helpers, persistence uniqueness/outbox records and invariant tests; narrow onchain reconciliation integration.
fields.Acceptance: Test repeated/cross-case requests, concurrent commitments, partial payments, unknown recoveries, crashes between persistence and delivery, receipt mismatches and reorgs. Distinguish policy loss keys from cross-policy occurrence/correlation identity. No double counting of paid and committed amounts or assets across rails.
fields.Security: Asset/recipient/purpose are immutable intent bindings; local state cannot manufacture financial-event proof or overwrite receipts.
fields.Complexity: L; split commitment reservation, delivery idempotency and reconciliation tests into reviewable commits.
fields.Compatibility: Retain existing net-loss/capital math and on-chain `lossKey` hashes. No live payout, accounting conversion or unsupported financial adapter.

tasks.title: Expose versioned discovery and dry-run APIs to humans and agents

fields.Objective: Serve the same approved definitions and authoritative outcomes through consistent typed interfaces.
fields.Files: Versioned web routes, domain wire contracts, HTTP SDK client and contract tests.
fields.Acceptance: Clients discover supported bundle versions, required input and capability limitations; submit revisions and request dry-run explanations with identical semantics. Test unauthorized/unapproved discovery, unknown versions, retries and human/agent parity.
fields.Security: Machine clients never receive server credentials or authority by knowing a route. Tenant and authorization checks remain server-side.
fields.Compatibility: Retain current remote procurement client/routes and Arc-only contract names behind explicit V1 adapters; do not expose server SQLite orchestration to browser bundles.

tasks.title: Add compatibility and shadow-evaluation regression gates

fields.Objective: Prove additive platform work preserves the current product and existing financial safeguards.
fields.Files: Oracle fixtures and integration tests across domain, insurance, SDK, web and copy-database migrations; CI targets as needed.
fields.Acceptance: Golden old terms digests, policy IDs and calldata stay byte-identical. Existing cases/read states remain interpretable. Shadow evaluations cover quote expiry, scheduled/effective coverage, contradictory evidence, unknown recoveries, duplicate loss and unsupported rail semantics. No private production DB is needed.
fields.Security: Mocks/fixtures are explicitly labeled; no live wallet, RPC-key disclosure or financial execution in regression CI.
fields.Compatibility: Fail rather than update goldens merely to accommodate a refactor. New contracts must not force historical reissuance.

tasks.title: Add a restricted Product Studio for governed registry operations

fields.Objective: Let authorized users draft/review definitions through allowlisted forms after registry semantics are proven.
fields.Files: New Build workspace product pages, scoped registry routes and UI/API tests.
fields.Acceptance: Draft versions, validation errors, diff/preview, review and retirement operate on the exact content approved. Authors cannot publish without grants; retired versions remain readable to permitted users. Published changes require a new version. Show referenced workflow capabilities rather than arbitrary code fields.
fields.Security: No editor control grants financial access; prevent cross-tenant reference selection and executable content injection.
fields.Complexity: L; ship draft/read/validation before review/publication UI.
fields.Compatibility: Preserve Protect procurement and claims UI. New authoring does not switch the live product or deploy configuration.

tasks.title: Expose operational health for workflow and financial projections

fields.Objective: Make freshness, failed work, authority refusals and per-policy versus portfolio warnings actionable.
fields.Files: Read-only health/projection services, worker instrumentation and scoped operations views/tests.
fields.Acceptance: Show checkpoint age, pending intents, retry/dead-letter reasons, reconciliation scope and correlation references without secrets. Test stale worker, unavailable RPC, superseded run, reorg and restore. Alerts do not imply payment or claim authorization.
fields.Security: Least-privilege operations reads; diagnostics redact credential-bearing URLs and confidential evidence.
fields.Compatibility: Extend the actual release supervisor/indexer; do not apply older documentation that predates the worker or disable fail-closed freshness controls.

tasks.title: Define and verify a gated migration and release runbook

fields.Objective: Approve the migration only after compatibility, operational recovery and insurance-role decisions are evidenced.
fields.Files: Docs, isolated staging/copy-database rehearsals and bounded verification scripts; CI release gates.
fields.Acceptance: Inventory old/new schema readers, backups, copy migration, restore, reversible opt-in and rollback preserving all issued records. Gate any real business on approved parties/jurisdictions/wording/rating/authority and data-handling arrangements. Keep AI advisory until a separately reviewed delegation and evaluation project authorizes more.
fields.Security: No gate removal, real issuance, signer introduction, production writes or deployment without separate authorization. Failures return to a safe read-only/legacy path without deleting evidence.
fields.Complexity: M for the runbook and isolated rehearsal, excluding any later deployment.
fields.Compatibility: Release branch stays stable. Rollback stops new creation; it does not erase new policy history or downgrade its meaning.
